newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amati initiated as a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amati initiated as a hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Friday initiated coverage of Amati Communications Corp with a hold recommendation, citing the company's potential to capitalize as its Internet access technology picks up steam in the late 1990s.

-- Dain Bosworth cited the acceptance by the American National Standards Institute of Amati's Discrete Multitone technology as the industry standard for Assymetric Digital Subscriber Line (ASDL) implementation, a high-speed Internet access transmission system.

-- Dain Bosworth analyst Charles Pluckhahn added he wants to see more evidence that key technology development and market acceptance have been met before recommending the purchase of the stocks of Amati or any other ASDL vendor.
-- Amati develops ADSL equipment that carries Internet data a high speeds over regular copper wire.
